text: {"name":"wlan_vht_capabilities_ie_append","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Appends the 12-byte 802.11 VHT Capabilities information element (EID 191) from the capability table and advances the caller's output cursor by 14 bytes.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"a1":"buffer_cursor_ref","v2":"vht_capability_defaults","v3":"ie_buffer","v4":"rx_mcs_map","v5":"rx_highest_rate","v6":"tx_mcs_map"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"802.11 element ID (0xBF, VHT Capabilities)"},{"offset":1,"meaning":"element payload length (12 bytes)"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"VHT Capabilities Info"},{"offset":6,"meaning":"RX VHT MCS map"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"RX highest supported VHT data rate"},{"offset":10,"meaning":"TX VHT MCS map"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"TX highest supported VHT data rate"}]}
